instruction: Export a LibreOffice Impress slideshow with transitions to WebM format and view it in VLC.

metadata.explanation: This is an infeasible task variation. LibreOffice Impress does not provide any native video recording or export functionality to WebM or any video format. The task requires screen recording capabilities that are not available in the standard LibreOffice suite, making it impossible to complete as specified.
